page.layout: One printed page with a single column of running text, and a narrow strip of the facing page's margin visible at the left edge, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: deinceps in tantum tumorem in-flat adulante tubâ, ut suspicienti Posteritati spes nulla relinquatur exæquandi; Contra verò novo-rum rectè facta, æquâ lance & suis ponderibus, non alienis examinantur. Quin etiam gratior est no-va Virtus, quæ jam primùm obscu-râ de plebe surgit: Dum ad instar exorientis sideris sensim emergit, & scandit horizontem illum, qui oblivionis ac silentii caliginem, à luce famæ & dignitatum fulgore discriminat: intuemur eam defixis oculis, & subinde miramur de cæ-ca nocte talem faculam prodire, & rapimur tacito quodam gaudio, & profequimur votis, & favemus. Accedit robustum & par Virtuti exercitium esse, ab imo luctari: eni-ti & exerere sese per compressa an-gustæ fortunæ latibula: devorare malevolorum odia, æqualium in-vidias.

page.notes: The left edge shows fragments of marginal notes and the gutter of the facing page; they are not legible enough to transcribe and are not part of this page's text. Some words are set with ligatures (ct, st) and were read as ct and st. The line ending "vidias," is printed flush right.
